events.title: 🎮 Steam China Showcase Live Streaming!
events.summary: 🎮 We're live for the Steam China Showcase!One More Plate! is a chaotic party game about one simple job: feed the hungry monsters before they lose it. Rotate the plate, guide the food, make a little physics mess — solo, or squished on the couch with friends.😎 Or, beat the dev in the new demo! 祥子 already took the Boss record with 00:54:99, putting me in second at 00:58:01🥈 So yes, the dev can be beaten. But I'm still #1 on Level 1 with 003352🥇Who's taking Level 1? Come get me!

events.title: 🎌We went to BitSummit the 13th: Summer of Yokai!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Last weekend, we had the joy of showcasing ONE MORE PLATE! at BitSummit in Kyoto — Japan’s biggest indie game festival! 🍱✨This time, we presented our Japan-themed world, full of hungry yokai, weird plates and food! The demo booth was packed and we were blown away by the laughter, screams and chaos from all of you who stopped by - it was so much fun seeing real players enjoy the game in person!
